admin-only: Only administrators can import from providers.
disabled: Provider imports are disabled. Enable ROM_PROVIDERS_ENABLED in the server configuration.
failed: The request failed. Check your connection and try again.
import-hint: The file is downloaded, checked, and added to your library. Existing files are never overwritten.
index-empty: Build the local index to search Minerva without its search API.
intro: Find games across providers and import them into your library.
no-downloads: No transfers yet. Choose a game to start an import.
no-results: No matches. Try fewer words or another platform.
search-hint: Search by title. Minerva also supports browsing by platform without a title.
title: ROM providers
torrent-disabled: Configure the provider qBittorrent connection on the server to use Minerva downloads.
verification: Open the provider and complete its download steps. Paste the generated direct download URL below.
